steps.title: Look one reply ahead
steps.body: For each candidate, ask what their best reply is, and whether you are still happy after it. That one extra step catches most blunders.
Rxd5 wins the queen. Their best reply does not change that, because nothing can recapture.

steps.q: After you pick a move, what do you ask?
steps.why: Their best reply decides whether your move works.

cards.prompt: What do you ask after choosing a move?
